headline: TWO SHOWINGS IN ONE SATURDAY ON RIDGE TRAIL AND ONE ON COMANCHE — the first live traffic Ridge Trail has taken since the cut, and the ShowingTime notices now print $550,000, which finally makes that price two-sourced. · DO: call Robert C. — the Rena buyer is now roughly 54 hours unreturned · WATCH: no Daily letter fired today, and Friday's landed 26 hours late.

notes: 🔴 NO DAILY LETTER FIRED TODAY, AND FRIDAY'S ARRIVED 26 HOURS LATE — verified two ways rather than carried forward: there is no the-daily heartbeat line anywhere in today's log, and a sent-mail search for the subject returns exactly one letter, the FRIDAY edition, timestamped 8:24 this morning. So the morning cockpit has now missed or badly slipped its slot on three consecutive days. The build queued to catch precisely this failure is still unshipped and now eight days old — it is on the build list below for the third board running.

✅ EVERYTHING ELSE RAN, AND RAN ALL DAY — roughly twenty on-time passes since 8:02 this morning with no dark window, the midday digest sent on schedule at 12:25, and the 3:15 pass correctly staying silent. One PARTIAL line, and it resolved well: a brand-new buyer lead's first-touch email hard-bounced one second after sending because her address is an Apple relay, and the lane converted her to a call inside four minutes rather than logging a delivery it did not get.

✅ THE 'INSTRUMENT IS DEAD' ALARM OF THE LAST TWO DAYS IS CLOSED AND IT WAS A MISREAD BOTH TIMES — there are TWO heartbeat files on this machine. The canonical one has been writing continuously all day; the copy sitting at the top of the OneDrive folder is a stale decoy that last moved yesterday morning. ⚠️ One genuine defect is still open: voicemail forwarding to the secondary company address has failed on every single attempt since 8/12 — seventeen bounce threads, no exceptions. Voicemails still reach the primary inbox, which is why nothing was lost.

callBlock.who: Robert C. — the 198 Rena buyer, now roughly fifty-four hours unreturned
callBlock.why: 🔥 THE OLDEST LIVE BUYER SIGNAL ON THE BOARD AND IT HAS ONLY GOTTEN WARMER. He phoned you directly on Thursday morning asking for photos of the workshop and the garage — not a form, a person who has studied the listing closely enough to know what is missing from it. 🆕 YOUR OWN NOTE AT 11:38 THIS MORNING PUT A LAST NAME TO HIM AND ESCALATED WHAT HE WANTS: this is no longer a photo request, it is a showing request. ⏰ AND STILL NOTHING HAS GONE OUT — six threads were re-read this afternoon and every one of them is our own mail. ⭐ On a listing that produced one written offer all summer, an unrepresented buyer asking to walk through is the cheapest at-bat you own. ⚠️ Stated honestly: if you called him from the truck it would not show here. Nothing else does either.

callBlock.who: Claire C. — brand-new buyer today, and the phone is the ONLY way to reach her
callBlock.why: 🆕 SHE REGISTERED AT 12:57 THIS AFTERNOON and the machine handled her end to end in four minutes: ownership verified, first touch sent at 1:01 — and it hard-bounced one second later. ⚠️ HER EMAIL IS AN APPLE PRIVATE-RELAY ADDRESS, which is the third time this exact pattern has been confirmed on this desk. There is no email path to her at all, now or later. ⭐ THAT MAKES THIS A DIFFERENT KIND OF TASK FROM THE REST OF THE LIST — every other name here can be worked two ways. This one cannot, and she is hours old, which is the only window where speed-to-lead is actually worth anything.

callBlock.who: Anonymous call-in lead — somebody phoned the CRM Friday afternoon and nobody has called back
callBlock.why: ☎️ A REAL HUMAN DIALLED YOUR NUMBER AT 4:18 FRIDAY AFTERNOON. The record carries no name and no email — the phone is the only channel that exists, so this one genuinely cannot be worked any other way. ⚠️ THE ALERT SAT UNREAD FROM FRIDAY EVENING UNTIL THIS MORNING'S SWEEP FOUND IT, which is the whole cost here: an inbound phone call is the highest-intent lead type on the board and this one is now more than a day cold. ⭐ Ownership is verified as yours at the strong rung, so there is no question about whether it is your lead to work.

callBlock.who: Thomas D. — he said YES yesterday morning, and the document he is waiting on now exists
callBlock.why: ✅ THIS IS THE ONE THAT UNBLOCKED ITSELF TODAY. He replied "Yes" at 8:44 yesterday and asked for the White Tail Run lot layout and the per-acre number. 🆕 THE 19-LOT PLAT WAS LOCATED AT 11:07 THIS MORNING — the exact deliverable his open chip has been waiting on since he answered. ⭐ SO THE CALL IS NO LONGER A HOLDING REPLY, IT IS A DELIVERY, which is a completely different conversation to have. 🔥 He is one of six names off the 19-lot ad, and that ad remains the only advertising in the portfolio producing anything at all.

callBlock.who: Gloria F. — the tenant answer is now twenty-two days owed
callBlock.why: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD. She waited nineteen days without complaining, then escalated three times in twenty-seven minutes on Wednesday night — two voicemails and a text. ✅ THE EMERGENCY HALF RESOLVED WITHOUT YOU: power is back on at the property and the tenant paid his balance, both confirmed. ⭐ THAT MAKES THE CALL EASIER, NOT UNNECESSARY — what she actually asked is still unanswered: is the tenant out, because he owes another month if he is not. ⭐ YOU DO NOT NEED THE ANSWER TO MAKE THE CALL, and waiting for one is exactly what turned six days into twenty-two.

callBlock.who: Chesley C. — four days unreturned, mid-transaction, on the cleanest deal you have
callBlock.why: ⚠️ THE ODD PART IS WHO THIS IS — not a cold lead but the seller on the file this board calls the cleanest on the board, with the inspection and the appraisal both already spent and the close receipted for 8/28. ⭐ A CLIENT MID-TRANSACTION WHO CALLS AND GETS NOTHING BACK IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE SILENCE YOU CAN BUY, because it costs the referral rather than the closing. ⚠️ There is live business on the same call: the payoff was reported as "forgotten" rather than ordered, and the appraised value still has not come back at day nine. Both are one phone call, not two.

callBlock.who: Angela B. and Cassie C. — the two agents who called Comanche too high and still have not been told it came down
callBlock.why: 🔴 BOTH CHIPS ARE NOW SEVEN DAYS OVERDUE AND TODAY MADE THE CASE STRONGER. Cassie's buyer toured 7/25, wrote the offer and called the old ask too high; Angela's buyer toured 8/2, said interested YES and called the same old ask too high. Neither knows the price moved. 🆕 THE HOUSE TOOK ANOTHER SHOWING AT 1:00 TODAY — seventeen all-time, still the highest-traffic active you own. ⭐ THE PATTERN SINCE THE CUT IS UNBROKEN ACROSS FOUR READS: one agent called the new number JUST RIGHT with a five-of-five, and not one person across seven reads has ever written down a different number. ⛔ Quote the current list price only, and call rather than email — co-op agents are the red lane under your own rule.

callBlock.who: Clint K. — he asked you a question on 8/3 and it has never been answered
callBlock.why: ⚠️ TWELVE DAYS. This is not a lead who went quiet — it is a person who asked you something directly and has been waiting since the first week of the month. ⭐ AN UNANSWERED DIRECT QUESTION IS A DIFFERENT CATEGORY FROM A COLD FOLLOW-UP, and it is the category that quietly ends relationships rather than costing opportunities. It takes one call and no selling. ⏰ Twelve days is past the point where an apology does the work on its own — lead with the answer instead.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $550K — TWO showings today, and the cut is finally two-sourced
listings.note: 🆕 THE BEST THING THAT HAPPENED ON THE BOARD TODAY, AND IT HAPPENED TWICE. Patti H. of Smartway walked it at 11:10 this morning and Drew T. of Keller Williams Vestavia walked it at 4:00 this afternoon — the all-time counter moved 41 to 42 inside six hours. ✅ THE SOURCE PROBLEM THIS BOARD FLAGGED FOR TWO DAYS IS NOW CLOSED: both of today's ShowingTime notices print the list price at $550,000. Every prior notice on file printed $559,000 because they all predated the cut, so the price was one source seen repeatedly. It is now confirmed independently and it is quotable. ⭐ AND THE TIMING IS THE POINT — the cut went live 8/13 and produced two tours within forty-eight hours on a house whose last read called it too high. That is the market answering the question directly. 🔴 NEITHER TOUR HAS FILED FEEDBACK YET, and the 8/10 tour before them never did either — three showings deep with nothing returned. 🔴 The item this board has carried unactioned for three weeks is still the one that would move the needle: the 7/23 read said dirty plus GLITCHING ELECTRICAL, and the 8/4 read scored staging 2 of 5, the lowest this listing has ever recorded, against a 4 three weeks earlier from an agent who called the price JUST RIGHT. The house did not get more expensive between those visits — it got less presentable. An electrician and a cleaner are still cheaper than another lost buyer, and now there are two fresh sets of eyes to ask.

listings.status: 🆕 Coming to market $185K — FULLY EXECUTED today, and the risk moved to the photographer
listings.note: ✅ THE SIGNATURE PROBLEM THIS BOARD LED WITH YESTERDAY IS SOLVED, COMPLETELY. Both sellers executed all seven documents this morning — she at 11:41, he at 11:49 — on three separate receipts, and the milestone engine fired this address for the first time in its life at 2:03 this afternoon. ⚠️ WORTH NAMING BECAUSE IT WAS ALMOST AN ALARM: the morning sweep flagged the agreement as maybe-unsigned six minutes into her signing session. It was a false positive by minutes, and it is logged as one rather than quietly dropped. 🔴 THE RISK DID NOT DISAPPEAR, IT MOVED — the sellers asked in writing on 8/12 for a MONDAY photo shoot and no photographer is booked. Today was the last business day before that shoot, and it is now evening. That is the single live item on this file. ⚠️ The $185,000 price is your own ruling and is quotable, but it still has no primary MLS source behind it. ⭐ Remember what this relationship actually is: she came in unprompted off a listing alert saying they were very interested in a property AND about ready to list their own. This is the LIST half of a two-sided deal, and the BUY half has never been worked.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — shown again today, garage question answered, one half still open
listings.note: 🆕 AMY G. OF ETHOS INTERNATIONAL SHOWED IT AT 1:00 THIS AFTERNOON and phoned from inside the house with a buyer standing there — seventeen showings all-time, still the highest-traffic active in the book. ✅ YOU CLOSED HALF OF IT YOURSELF BY TEXT BETWEEN 4:16 AND 4:20: the four-car side garage question is answered and the stale task chasing you for it has been corrected. 🔴 THE OTHER HALF IS STILL OPEN AND IT IS THE ONE THAT COSTS SOMETHING — she also reported the basement lights would not turn on, which is a live buyer standing in a dark basement, and it has its own chip now. ⚠️ No offer language was used, so this is deliberately NOT being called an incoming offer. ⭐ THE CAUSAL CHAIN REMAINS THE MOST USEFUL FINDING ON YOUR ACTIVE BOARD: every read that ever said TOO HIGH was filed while the ask was $299,000; the cut went live 8/5; since then one JUST RIGHT with a five-of-five, one stairs complaint, and nothing about the number. A $4,000 experiment that worked. 🔴 Two co-op agents who expressed buyer interest still do not know the price moved — both chips overdue since 8/8. ⛔ Quote $295,000 only. ⛔ Call, don't email. ⚠️ One older thread is still unanswered: the 8/10 agent asked in writing whether the ceiling stains came from a previous leak.

listings.status: ⚖️ Active $450K — the agreement window passed unruled, and the buyer is still unreturned
listings.note: ⏰ THE DECISION CHIP EXPIRED WITHOUT A RULING and has been closed as expired rather than left to rot on the board. What replaces it is a factual question, not a strategy question: what is the actual agreement status now. ⚠️ STATED PLAINLY — the expiry date itself has never had a document behind it. This desk has carried 8/14 and 8/17 on different passes and neither is receipted, so the honest position is that the paperwork needs reading before anything else is decided. 🔴 THE LIVE HUMAN ITEM IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS TONIGHT: Robert C. phoned Thursday morning about the workshop and garage, your own note this morning escalated him from photos to a showing, and he is now roughly fifty-four hours unreturned with zero outbound on any channel this desk can read. ⭐ THE PRICING PICTURE IS UNCHANGED AND NOTHING SINCE HAS MOVED IT: day 90, no price change since May, exactly one written offer all summer, the 8/11 full-price showing this board carried for two days NEVER HAPPENED by the agent's own admission, and Friday's tour ran and produced total silence. ⭐ Both feedback forms this house has ever produced left every price field blank — the objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior. Nobody who walked it has ever named a different number. ⚠️ Quote $450,000 only until the sellers rule. ⚠️ Mrs Ann has still not been asked — and it is a REINSTATEMENT, not an extension, per the 9:35 reply Friday.

listings.status: 🎉 Under contract $390,000 — repair request IS in, and the response is drafted and waiting
listings.note: ✅ THE DOCUMENT THIS BOARD SAID WAS MISSING FOR TWO DAYS HAS LANDED — the buyers' signed repair addendum arrived and the response to the sellers is written and sitting in drafts, roughly seven hours old. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE ASK IS THE STORY AND IT IS GOOD NEWS: they inspected seventy-one items, flagged sixty-eight at some level, and then asked for exactly three. That is a reasonable buyer. ⭐ THE RECOMMENDATION IN THE DRAFT IS TWO YESES AND A HOLD — agree to the basement leak and to a scoped HVAC service, and on the roof do not say no, say give us a few days and our own licensed roofer's report. The inspector wrote in the same section that he cannot determine the roof's age or remaining life, which is the report itself saying the roof question is unanswered. ⚠️ TWO THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE FIGHTING THE ROOF: this is FHA, so the appraiser can raise it independently, and the concession room left under the FHA cap is small, so this gets solved with work rather than a check. ⭐ THE CLOSING DATE IS NOW RESOLVED AT 10/23 off your own seller brief — roughly ten weeks, which is a luxury most files do not get. 🔴 The live item is the DRAFT: it is written, it is unsent, and the sellers cannot act on a document sitting in a folder.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — closes THURSDAY 8/20, and it is the quietest high-risk file you have
listings.note: ⏰ FIVE DAYS OUT AND THIS IS NOW THE NEAREST CLOSING ON THE BOARD. ✅ What is verified and good: the appraisal is complete and clean on the lender's own words, the repair addendum is fully executed, the septic inspection ran 8/4, and the closing invite matches the stored state on the engine's own check. ⭐ CLOSING IS THURSDAY 8/20 AT 3:00 PM at the closing attorney's office. ⚠️ THE HONEST WORRY IS THE SILENCE, NOT A PROBLEM — this desk described it earlier this week as the quietest high-risk file in the book, and nothing has come in since. On the largest number closing this month, five days out with no traffic is worth one confirmation call to the attorney rather than an assumption. ⛔ The old 8/14 close date is retired — do not re-print it anywhere. ⭐ One thing worth having ready: a closing this size is the strongest referral moment you will get this month, and the review-ask on the last funded closing is still sitting untouched at twenty-five days.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract — both gates cleared, close 8/28, and the seller is still waiting on a call
listings.note: ✅ STILL THE CLEANEST FILE ON YOUR BOARD ON PAPER. Both gates are behind you: the inspection ran 8/5 at noon and the appraisal 8/7 at 9:00 AM, both on primary notices, and the closing invite matches the stored state. ⭐ AN INSPECTION AND AN APPRAISAL BOTH SPENT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION ANY DEAL ON THIS BOARD OCCUPIES. 🔴 AND YET THE SELLER HAS BEEN WAITING ON A RETURNED CALL SINCE TUESDAY — four days now, mid-transaction, on the deal with the least to worry about. That is the row on this file that needs you. ⚠️ THE PAYOFF WEAKENED RATHER THAN FIRMED: it was reported as "forgotten" rather than ordered, and forgotten is not ordered, ordered is not received by title. ⚠️ The appraised value still has not come back — day nine, reported as a single-source observation rather than an alarm, and worth one call to the lender. ⚠️ One number remains unruled and it is worth real money on an otherwise settled deal: the buyer's agent asked for a specific co-op commission and nobody has ever answered.

listings.status: 🎉 Under contract $162K — inspection held, both price reads validated the number
listings.note: ✅ THE FIRST GATE IS BEHIND YOU — inspection confirmed and held 8/13 at 10:00 AM; MLS reads CONTINGENT. ✅ THE PAPERWORK ITEM IS CLOSED, NOT PENDING: the contract went out with all signatures, the contract-to-close packet reached title 8/12, and the closing attorney confirmed receipt. ⭐ TWO INDEPENDENT READS NOW VALIDATE THIS PRICE — the agent who wrote the offer called it JUST RIGHT, and a late form off the 8/7 tour said interested No but PRICED JUST RIGHT with a staging 3 of 5. That is the kind of evidence that matters if anything wobbles before 9/14. ⭐ THE BACKSTORY IS WORTH KEEPING ON THE RECORD: the buyer's agent said her client really liked it but needed to save more for a down payment, and this desk argued for two weeks against reading that as a price signal — she had written JUST RIGHT on the same form. She wrote. Offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. Patience was the right call. ⭐ Closing 9/14.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $184K — a 'VERY interested' buyer is now seven days unworked
listings.note: 🔥 THE LISTING THIS BOARD ONCE CALLED INVISIBLE PRODUCED THREE TOURS IN A SINGLE SATURDAY, all three forms filed within ninety minutes of each other on 8/8. One answered the interest question with the single word "Very" and left every other field blank — which is exactly why it needs a phone call: the enthusiasm is on record and the reason is not. ✅ THE $5,000 CUT IS VERIFIED LIVE AND PUBLIC — the MLS line on all three notices reads $184,000, so the old do-not-quote hedge is retired. 🔴 THE REAL FINDING IS THE OBJECTION AND IT IS VERIFIED THREE WAYS: the problem is SIZE, not price. The clearest read says it in four words — "Just too small." ⛔ NO DISCOUNT REACHES A SIZE OBJECTION. The answer here is AUDIENCE — first-time buyers, downsizers, investors — and a price conversation with this seller would be solving the wrong problem. This board argued for a cut here for weeks on the strength of silence; the showings arrived and said something different, and that earlier read is withdrawn. 🔴 That Saturday burst has now fully decayed with the one phone call still unmade.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $599K package — the plat turned up today, and the builder question is finally answerable
listings.note: ✅ THE DELIVERABLE WAS LOCATED THIS MORNING AT 11:07 — the 19-lot plat, which is precisely what the open buyer chip has been waiting on since he answered "Yes" yesterday. That call stops being a holding reply and becomes a delivery. 🔴 THE PERC QUESTION IS STILL THE GATE AND IT IS PRICED RATHER THAN BLOCKED: the county takes record searches in person only, weekdays 8:00 to 3:30, at a per-record fee — across nineteen lots that is a four-figure errand. ⭐ SO THE CHOICE IS THREE-WAY, NOT TWO: send someone for all nineteen, narrow the pull to the lots a buyer is actually asking about, or try the free path first and ask the developer, who almost certainly already holds the perc results from platting. ⭐ PERC DECIDES BUILDABILITY AND BUILDABILITY DECIDES PRICE PER LOT, which is why this one question governs the whole package. 🔥 SIX NAMES OFF THIS AD NOW, while every other ad in the portfolio produced zero. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses hard-bounced permanently after 48 hours of retries — part of the builder audience for this package received nothing at all, and those two need replacing rather than resending. ⭐ Blocks and takedowns at a higher per-lot number remain acceptable per the seller's own ruling.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — fifteen days quiet, and the good news is STILL undelivered
listings.note: 🔴 TWO TOURS IN FIVE DAYS AT THE END OF JULY, THEN NOTHING SINCE. On a listing that had gone 126 days with essentially no traffic, that brief burst was the only real activity this file has produced and it has fully decayed. ⭐ THE GOOD NEWS IS STILL UNDELIVERED AT FIFTEEN DAYS, WHICH MAKES IT THE OLDEST OWED ITEM ON THE BOARD: the 7/31 read came back interested No, but with the price called JUST RIGHT, a 4 of 5 rating, and the comment that the buyers prefer the east end of the beach although they liked this complex. That is a GEOGRAPHY loss, not a price loss, and it is the only independent validation of this list price the file has ever carried. ⭐ He is out of state and lives on these reads — lead with the price answer, not the no. ⚠️ A price discrepancy opened during the dark window and is still unresolved: two sources five thousand apart, and neither is quotable until the MLS is read directly.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — biggest listing in the book, seller identity STILL unverified
listings.note: ⚠️ THE LARGEST NUMBER ON YOUR BOARD IS STILL THE ONE WITH THE WEAKEST FILE. No showing, no feedback and no correspondence has crossed this desk on this address in the fourteen-day window. ⛔ THE CLIENT IDENTITY REMAINS UNVERIFIED under the identity law — a name is carried in memory, and memory is not a receipt. On a $1.15M listing that is not a formality: it gates every piece of client-facing creative and every seller email. ⭐ THE POSITIONING READ IS STILL THE MOST USEFUL THING ON THE FILE: the only tour this listing ever took said, verbatim, that the buyer liked the house but the land wasn't what he was looking for. The objection is ACREAGE — which at this price point is the cheapest possible loss, because nobody has ever said it is too expensive. ⭐ THE UNANSWERED QUESTION IS THEREFORE A TARGETING ONE: who is the buyer who wants THIS land, and is the marketing pointed at them. ⏰ The 8/2 open house was never debriefed and its sign-in sheet was never captured — thirteen days on, that is effectively lost. 🛑 The lookalike meeting link on this address is still not to be opened, on any device.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active — price cut to $285K on 8/11, and the live ad still shows the old number
listings.note: ⚠️ A PRICE CUT THAT THE MARKETING NEVER HEARD ABOUT, NOW ON DAY FIVE. The listing came down to $285,000 on 8/11 per the CRM's own field, while an 8/8 social post that is still live carries $289,900. ⭐ THAT IS A CHEAP FIX AND A REAL ONE — a public ad quoting a dead number is the kind of small inconsistency buyers and agents actually notice, and it makes every other number you publish slightly less trustworthy. ⚠️ THIS IS TWO ARTIFACTS RATHER THAN TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES, so it is printed as a waiting-on-you item rather than a red flag: the CRM field and the live post disagree, and the MLS has not been read directly to break the tie. ⭐ The corrected creative has been staged for approval since Wednesday, which makes the whole item one click rather than a project.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — the tenant answer is twenty-two days owed
listings.note: 🔴 THE LONGEST-RUNNING BROKEN PROMISE ON THE BOARD, AND IT FINALLY BROKE HER PATIENCE. She left a twenty-two-second voicemail on 7/25 rather than sending a seventh text — which is what a patient client does when nothing comes back — and then on Wednesday night she escalated THREE TIMES IN TWENTY-SEVEN MINUTES: two voicemails and a text. ✅ THE EMERGENCY HALF RESOLVED WITHOUT YOU — power is back on at the property and the tenant paid his balance, both confirmed this week. ⭐ THE OWED THING IS STILL YOURS: she asked whether the tenant on this unit is out, because he owes another month's rent if he isn't. ⚠️ YOU DO NOT NEED AN ANSWER TO MAKE THIS CALL. "Still no word from him, here's exactly what I'm doing about it" beats a twenty-third day of silence. ⭐ She is not a loose end — she closed with you in June, still opens your market reports, and has an unclosed valuation loop on this same address.

listings.status: 🆕 Buyer-side pending — long fuse, one answer owed
listings.note: 🆕 REAL GCI THE FORECAST COULD NOT SEE UNTIL LAST WEEK — roughly $44.6K across this address and a second buyer-side file, both weighted at zero in every prior model. That is not new business; it is business you already had that the system was blind to. ⭐ ONE LIVE OPEN ITEM AND IT IS NOW MORE THAN TWO WEEKS OLD: a builder change-order and pre-qualification message, deliberately left in the inbox rather than filed because it is the only thing on this file that wants an answer. ⚠️ Long fuse — it closes late January 2027 with a production builder — so the change order is the only item carrying urgency, and two weeks of silence on a builder question is how change orders get decided without you.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the counter has never been put on paper, day 25
listings.note: 🔴 THE LARGEST SINGLE NUMBER ON YOUR BOARD, ROUGHLY $36K OF GCI, AND THE WHOLE COST OF MOVING IT IS TWENTY MINUTES OF WRITING. The listing side has asked repeatedly since 7/21 to be moved forward and has never received a written position from your side. ⚠️ STATED HONESTLY: a phone call leaves no receipt, so this is ABSENCE rather than proven failure — but what was promised was paper, and there is none on any lane this desk can read. ⭐ WHY IT KEEPS RETURNING: a seller who reverse-offers a buyer is a seller who wants a deal, and the honest answer IS the counter. Sending it is not a favour to them; it is your position on the record. ⚠️ NOT ASSERTED, AND THIS MATTERS BEFORE ANYTHING GOES OVER: the appraisal figure your buyer cited as far under ask is single-sourced from him. Whose appraisal it is, when it was done, and whether it is a formal appraisal at all are all unknown. Do not quote it to the other side as an appraised value. ⚠️ Three feedback requests from the listing side also remain unanswered.

listings.status: 🎉 Closed + funded — and the referral window on both is wide open
listings.note: ⏰ THE POST-CLOSE REVIEW-ASK ON LAKE FOREST IS NOW TWENTY-FIVE DAYS OPEN. On a board where the large majority of this year's closings came from relationships rather than ads, and which needs roughly two contracts a week to reach the goal, this is the single cheapest referral at-bat available and it has sat untouched for three and a half weeks. The gratitude call queued a month ago still has not happened. ⚠️ One open courtesy: the other office still owes those sellers the deed for utilities. 🎯 WHISPERING PINES IS STILL THE ONE UNRESOLVED UNIT IN THE COUNT, and it is worth a number: settling the agent-of-record in your favour makes the year 23 instead of 22 and moves pace by nearly two full closings. That is production that costs a conversation and no selling — carried unresolved for more than a dozen boards now. ⚠️ The dossier index says it is a teammate's file and this console says contested; one of those is wrong and only the conversation settles it.

pipeline.note: 🟢 22 OF 45 AT DAY 227, ANNUALIZING TO ABOUT 36 — and the counter moved TWICE in one week for the first time this year: 1709 Fieldstone at $390,000 on 8/8 (ten thousand ABOVE list) and 3350 Altamont at $162,000 on 8/11, offer to acceptance in twenty-eight minutes. ⚠️ ONE DESK CONFLICT IS PRINTED HONESTLY RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: the money desk counts 22 and the finance desk counts 21. This board counts 22 on the strength of the 683 Flag closing receipt; one file needs correcting so the two agree, and it still has not been corrected. ⭐ THE STRATEGIC POINT IS BIGGER THAN THE TWO UNITS: ten days ago the forecast named eight actives and asked which two would convert by October 31. Two of them converted inside nine days with no new lead generation at all. THE LISTINGS YOU ALREADY HAVE ARE THE CHEAPEST CONTRACTS AVAILABLE TO YOU — that thesis has receipts, and it is why today's Ridge Trail double-showing and the two overdue Comanche agent calls sit above any prospecting task. ⏰ THE WINDOW IS SHORTER THAN THE CALENDAR: at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything closing in 2026 must be under contract by roughly October 31. That is eleven weeks, not twenty. ⚠️ The most recent forecast ran as a catch-up on 8/12 and is PARTIAL — the pipeline was read from an 8/6 crawl rather than a fresh pull and two files remain unpriced, so treat the risk-weighted number as directional.
